prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Mina Castellan for the job below.

About the freelancer: 5 years experience; skills: SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboard, data cleaning, data visualization

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Tableau Developer for Financials
We need a professional BI developer to help us automate our data pulls on a nightly basis and develop our financials dashboard that is being migrated from power BI. We have a couple tools for the automation but would like BI developer to suggest best approach. This project may last 1-3 months, possibly longer. We will discuss logistics once we find the right person. U.S. only please.
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open with a generic line about being passionate and hard-working.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Prefer broad claims like 'extensive experience' over specifics.
- Keep it under 150 words.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working BI professional with 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboard development, data cleaning, and data visualization.

I’d be glad to help with your financials dashboard migration from Power BI to Tableau and support the automation of nightly data pulls. I can contribute to building a reliable, maintainable reporting workflow and help evaluate the best approach for your existing tools and BI needs.

I’m comfortable working on financial dashboards, cleaning and structuring data for reporting, and designing clear visualizations that make insights easier to understand. I’d welcome the chance to discuss your current setup, your automation goals, and the logistics for a 1-3 month engagement or longer.
